summary: The analysis identifies a strong cluster of confounders among patient-reported quality-of-life scores (EORTC QLQ-C30) and employment status, all showing highly consistent treatment and outcome prognosis signals. Effect modification is prominently seen in emphysema and enzyme elevation, and moderately in EGFR mutation status. Physical and emotional functioning scores show moderate interaction signals but are primarily driven by confounding. Nausea and embolism presence provided insufficient evidence for any role.
